name: fpl-copilot
description: Fantasy football projections from fplcopilot.com: team ratings, captain picks, player cards, fixture difficulty, Wildcard squads and mini-league chances.

interface.longDescription:
fplcopilot (fplcopilot.com) is an independent fantasy football assistant with its own projections.

Ask about your fantasy football team and get answers from fplcopilot's live projections, with interactive cards:

- Rate my team: a 0–100 score against the best squad you could own over the next five gameweeks, with the biggest fixes. Give your team ID or link, or share a screenshot of your team.
- Expected points: the best players by position, price, club or ownership, gameweek by gameweek, plus value picks and differentials.
- Player cards: expected points per gameweek with fixtures, injury news, price-change progress, ownership and xG/xA.
- Also captain picks, mini-league standings and win chances, fixture difficulty, penalty takers, price changes, predicted lineups, Wildcard and Free Hit squads, gameweek reviews, and our guides.

It only reads data and never changes your team. One action writes: a card's Share button publishes that card to a public fplcopilot.com page. Numbers update as team news breaks, and each card links to the full view on fplcopilot.com.

positive.description: Rate a fantasy football team by its team ID
positive.prompt: Rate my fantasy football team, my ID is 139602
positive.expected_behavior: A score out of 100 for team 139602, its biggest fixes, and the squad on a pitch card.

positive.description: Captain picks for the next gameweek
positive.prompt: Who should I captain this gameweek?
positive.expected_behavior: The top captain options for the next gameweek with expected points and fixtures, on a captain card.

positive.description: Find players by position and price
positive.prompt: Best midfielders under £8m for the next 5 gameweeks
positive.expected_behavior: Midfielders priced £8.0m or less, ranked by expected points, with a column for each of the next 5 gameweeks.
Haaland's expected points per gameweek with fixtures, news, price and ownership, on a player card.
Brighton's penalty takers with each one's chance of being the main taker.

negative.description: Off topic: no fplcopilot tool is called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: No tool changes a team: the assistant says the tools only read data and can suggest moves from them.
negative.prompt: Make three transfers in my team for me

negative.description: Betting is out of scope: no tool is called.
negative.prompt: Put £10 on Arsenal to win on Saturday

publication.release_notes: fplcopilot is the developer's own brand: the domain fplcopilot.com and the same name on our social accounts. The plugin names no other company, product or league and claims no affiliation; it answers from fplcopilot's own projections, not as a connector to another service. One tool writes: a card's Share button publishes that card, as the server stored it, to a public fplcopilot.com page. No account is needed; any team ID works for testing, for example 139602.
